params.body:
The workbench screen now handles refusals, ending a word, and a session that ends in the middle of a touch. It reads Portal's new fields as optional, so it also runs against the Portal that is live now. The paired Portal proposal (same branch name) adds the routes and names.

**A way out per refusal.** `PortalApi` raises `Refused(status, reason, message)` from Portal's `{"message", "refused"}`, and `Unreachable` when there is no answer at all. `api/WayOut.kt` maps each to one action that is shown under the sentence:

| refusal | offered |
|---|---|
| `ask_again`, `signature` | Touch again |
| `outside_working_set` | Admit for the rest of the day instead |
| `working_set_ended` | Look again |
| `no_passkey`, `key_unknown` | Open your keys in Portal |
| `key_not_yours`, 401 | Sign in again |
| `no_working_set` | a note: it needs the YubiKey, at the laptop for now |
| no answer, 5xx | Try again (the same action) |

A screen that fails to load gets a Retry action next to the pull-down.

**Ending without a key.** A project with a word in force shows "end now", and a standing working set shows "end the working set now". Each asks once in place before it posts to `/app/workbench/revoke` or `/app/workbench/working-set/end`.

**Kept across signing in.** If the session ends during a touch, the app keeps the duration and the selection. After the passkey sign-in, the workbench opens with the same projects ticked and says so. It does not repeat the touch on its own.

**docs/protocol.md** documents the routes, the refusal names, what ending does and does not reach (a capability the hand already holds stands at the gateway until it expires, plus a sketch of a revocation list the gateway pulls the way it pulls its policy log), and the planned YubiKey-over-NFC signing (PIV Ed25519 through yubikit-android). Nothing of the NFC part is built.

Tests: `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` passes. It now includes `WayOutTest` (refusal parsing and every mapping) and a screenshot of a refusal with its way out. `screens/workbench.json` is regenerated from Portal's `AppApiTest`.
params.title: Workbench: a way out of every refusal, ending a word, the touch kept across signing in
